semantics.function: parity equals XOR of all eight input data bits, making the total number of ones in the nine-bit word even
semantics.timing: Combinational; original problem defines a byte-to-parity function and provides no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No state or specified initial value; output follows the current input

numeric.known_binary_rule: parity is the input population count modulo 2
numeric.four_state_rule: Verilog XOR propagates X or Z input bits to unknown parity

verification.oracle: Independently count set bits and compute remainder modulo 2, based on the original even-parity statement
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 256 binary bytes including zero, all ones, single-bit and complementary patterns; supplementary X/Z propagation checks
verification.sampling: Drive input and sample after one simulation time unit for combinational settling
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Original text does not specify behavior for X/Z inputs; standard four-state XOR semantics are used and checked supplementally.
